description: This file is a shell script used to test the 'git apply' functionality within a git repository. It sets up various repository states and applies patches to verify correct behavior of git in handling type changes, renames, symlinks, and binary files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function used to define a successful test case, taking a description and a shell command to execute.

methods.name: test_debug
methods.description: A function to output debugging information, typically the contents of patches.

methods.description: A helper function to create symbolic links for testing purposes.
